description: 2016 Audi S6 Premium Plus For Sale Finished in Moonlight Blue Metallic, this 2016 Audi S6 Premium Plus is a sharp example of Audi's facelifted C7.5 sport sedan, pairing understated styling with serious performance. Power comes from Audi's 4.0L twin-turbocharged V8, backed by a 7-speed S tronic dual-clutch automatic and quattro all-wheel drive. It carries the same basic 4.0T architecture found across other high-performance Audi models like the S7, S8, and RS7, as well as certain Bentley applications, and it's easy to understand why enthusiasts continue to seek these cars out. The engine is smooth, strong, and responsive, with a deep V8 note that feels more mechanical and authentic than the newer hybrid-assisted S-cars.Part of the appeal of the C7 S6 is how subtle it is. To most people it looks like a well-optioned A6, but those who know these cars will spot the S-model details right away: the quad exhaust outlets, aluminum-look mirror caps, more aggressive stance, and the overall balance of performance without excess. The 2016 model year is especially desirable because it brought the C7.5 update, including revised front and rear styling, sharper LED lighting, updated MMI, and the later 7-speed S tronic that helped refine both daily drivability and performance. These cars are quick in stock form, capable of low-4-second 0-60 times, and the 4.0T platform is well known for responding extremely well to ECU and TCU tuning for those who want even more out of it.Inside, the S6 delivers the kind of cabin that helped define Audi in this era, with high-quality materials, a clean driver-focused layout, and the physical buttons and controls that many buyers still prefer. The Premium Plus trim adds to the car's all-around usability, while the S6 itself brings the right mix of comfort, speed, and understated presence. For many enthusiasts, the C7.5 S6 hits a sweet spot: V8 power, dual-clutch transmission, all-wheel-drive confidence, and a more connected feel than what came after.
